note: Master brief for the 15 demo pages. The hub (demos/index.html), the research agents, the page authors and the QA all read this file. Everything in it is FICTIONAL (people, places, shops, phone numbers use 555 / example.com).

demos.title: The Hollow Hill Masquerade
demos.tagline: An adults-only Halloween house party by candlelight
demos.mood: Dark, candle-lit gothic: near-black plum, bone white, tarnished gold, blood red. Serif display type (Cinzel / Cormorant / IM Fell), grainy photos, flicker of candlelight.
demos.must: Masquerade dress code, 'midnight unmasking' schedule, signature cocktails menu (cauldron punch, 'Bloody Hour' etc.), house rules (no real knives, no photos in the Séance Room), RSVP with +1 and costume field, add-to-calendar, FAQ (parking, coat check, sober-ride list), a hidden-until-midnight easter egg.

photos.want: wide, moody: glowing jack-o'-lanterns or candle-lit haunted atmosphere, lots of dark negative space for text
elegant masquerade / venetian masks, adult costume
dark moody cocktail or potion-like drink, smoke or dry-ice optional
candelabra / candles / skulls table decor, gothic
spooky old mansion, foggy woods, or haunted-house exterior
adults in Halloween costumes at a party (not identifiable close-ups preferred)
spooky food: skull cake, black cupcakes, witch-finger cookies

demos.title: Pumpkin Patch Boo Bash
demos.tagline: A little-monsters costume party and trick-or-treat trail for ages 3 to 9
demos.mood: Bright and silly-spooky for kids: pumpkin orange, grape purple, slime green, cream. Rounded playful type (Fredoka / Baloo / Chewy), sticker-like badges, wobbly rotated cards.
demos.must: Costume parade at 3pm, trick-or-treat trail map (numbered stops, uses live map-pin-number icons), craft stations (pumpkin painting, mummy wrap race), snack menu with allergen tags (nut-free!), what to bring, parents' drop-off vs stay info, RSVP with kids' names + allergies, add-to-calendar.

photos.want: kids in cheerful Halloween costumes with pumpkins, daylight, smiling
pumpkin patch / rows of orange pumpkins
halloween cupcakes / cookies decorated by kids
kids painting or carving pumpkins, craft table

kids party games outdoors, autumn leaves

demos.title: Diwali at the Mehta House
demos.tagline: Lakshmi puja, a long table of mithai and diyas on every sill
demos.mood: Warm, elegant, family-run: deep maroon and saffron, marigold orange, pink, gold leaf. Serif display (Cormorant / Playfair / Yatra One for accents), rangoli-inspired CSS patterns. Clean and brand-friendly rather than over-ornate.
demos.must: Puja timing (muhurat shown as a plain-language schedule), dress code (festive Indian or smart), vegetarian menu with dish names and region (kaju katli, dal makhani, paneer tikka, jalebi...), 'bring a diya' note, kids' rangoli corner, shoes-off note, parking, WhatsApp-style RSVP form (adults/kids, dietary, bringing a sweet?), add-to-calendar, a gentle 'Happy Diwali / Shubh Deepavali' sign-off.

photos.want: rows of lit diyas, warm golden bokeh, wide
Indian sweets mithai on a plate (kaju katli, ladoo, jalebi)
festive Indian vegetarian dinner thali or dishes on a table
family or hands lighting a diya / puja, warm light
fairy lights / lanterns / lit house at night for Diwali
sparklers phuljhadi or festive fireworks (kid-safe feeling)

demos.tagline: A neighbourhood festival of lights: food stalls, garba, rangoli contest and fireworks

demos.title: Last Rooftop of the Season
demos.tagline: Sunset to skyline: a house party on the roof before the cold comes

event.venue: The roof at 9 Foundry Street, apt 4C (fictional)

demos.mood: Dusk-to-night gradients: electric violet, hot pink, sunset orange, deep navy. Glassy cards, big grotesk type (Space Grotesk / Syne / Unbounded), glow effects. Feels like a good party flyer meets an event app.

demos.title: Sunny Day Playdate
demos.tagline: Toddlers, bubbles and a picnic blanket in the Reyes backyard
demos.mood: Soft sunny pastels for ages 1 to 4 and their grown-ups: butter yellow, sky blue, blush, mint. Friendly rounded type (Nunito / Quicksand / Baloo 2), hand-drawn-feeling shapes, big tap targets. Calm and warm, not loud.
demos.must: Plain-language plan for the 2 hours (arrival and shoes off, free play, bubble time, snack, story circle), what to bring (water bottle, change of clothes, sun hat, one snack to share), allergy-aware snack list, parent-info panel (nap windows, stroller parking, changing station, bathroom, rain plan), weather-check live icon, RSVP with child's name + age + allergies, small 'friends coming' avatar row.

photos.want: toddlers playing happily outdoors in sunshine, wide, soft light

parents chatting with coffee while kids play

demos.title: Nani Rosa Turns 80
demos.tagline: A surprise lunch for the woman who fed us all

event.venue: The Garden Room at Fennel & Fig, 6 Orchard Walk (fictional)
event.host: Her grandchildren: Isa, Mateo, Noor & Kit

demos.mood: Warm, tender and a little vintage, like a family photo album: cream paper, rose, sage, butter yellow, faded gold. Serif display (Fraunces / Playfair / Lora) plus a handwriting accent (Caveat / Homemade Apple). Large, easy-to-read text because many readers are older; high contrast.
demos.must: SURPRISE logistics ('please arrive by 12:00, she arrives 12:30, don't post online'), a photo-timeline strip of her life (1946 to 2026 with 5 milestones), memory-wall form (leave a memory, shows instantly on page), menu (her favourite dishes), accessibility info (step-free, parking, seating), gift note ('no gifts, bring a recipe card or a story'), RSVP with dietary + 'can you share a memory', add-to-calendar, big readable type.

demos.title: Hartwell & Sons Hardware
demos.tagline: Serving the neighbourhood since 1952. Ask us how, we'll show you
demos.brand: Third-generation family hardware store (fictional), est. 1952. Phone orders and in-store pickup are king; the web shop is new. Open Mon-Sat 7am-6pm, Sun 9-3. Key cutting, paint mixing, tool rental, free advice.
demos.mood: Old-school printed catalogue: aged cream paper, forest green, tool-box red, ink black, brass accents. Slab/serif display (Alfa Slab One / Rokkitt / Bitter) and a typewriter-ish mono (Courier Prime / Special Elite) for part numbers. Rules, boxed ads, 'Est. 1952' stamps. Deliberately NOT slick.
demos.must: Big phone number + hours at the top, 'Basic' mode should feel like the plain, text-heavy site they have today (and Upgraded is the same content with icons and order), department index (Hand tools, Power tools, Paint, Plumbing, Electrical, Garden, Fasteners, Lumber), catalogue-style product list with part numbers and prices, quick search that filters, 'Pick-up in 2 hours' basket (works), services panel (key cutting, paint matching, screen repair, tool rental with a daily rate table), 'ask Walt' how-to tips cards, store map/hours/address, local-pride blurb.
